purpose: Apply Industrial UI Modernizer workflows to AssetPlan without duplicating or overriding AssetPlan product truth, visual governance, component lifecycle, or IAP adoption boundaries.

authorityPrecedence.rule: Current AssetPlan ADRs, standards, registries, contracts, gates and runtime evidence always outrank this profile and generic IUM guidance.

authorityPrecedence.authority: IAP contracts and shared assets explicitly adopted by AssetPlan
authorityPrecedence.rule: IAP may govern product-independent contracts, but an IAP candidate does not become an AssetPlan baseline until AssetPlan adopts it through its governed registry, host contract or explicit product decision.
IUM supplies design-engineering, audit, migration and validation methods. It must not redefine AssetPlan business semantics, visual tokens, component lifecycle or product gates.

componentResolution.rule: Resolve by capabilityId and allowedForNewScreens at execution time. Never select a component because it has the highest RC/R/V suffix.

visualTruth.rule: Use AssetPlan's current visual standards and Studio evidence. IUM generic DESIGN.md is a quality floor only and cannot replace AssetPlan's visual system.

functionalTruth.rule: A screenshot proves appearance, not behavior. Power Apps source, flows, SQL/data contracts, ADRs and runtime evidence govern behavior.

iapBoundary.rule: Shared IAP contracts/assets are eligible only after explicit AssetPlan adoption. Product branding, domain semantics, navigation composition and unpromoted candidates remain AssetPlan-owned.

commands.shape: Use AssetPlan archetypes, product standards and current component registry before proposing structure.
commands.audit: Run AssetPlan governance/guardian checks plus IUM technical audit; report them separately.
commands.critique: Evaluate operational clarity without replacing AssetPlan visual DNA.
commands.polish: Preserve current AssetPlan component and product contracts; no local visual system.
commands.adapt: Use reflow/recomposition while preserving AssetPlan shell/context/hierarchy contracts.
commands.harden: Preserve AssetPlan truth states, Async Action Guard and governed backend boundaries.
commands.extract: Promote reusable candidates only through AssetPlan/IAP lifecycle rules; do not silently centralize product logic.
commands.recreate: Treat references as visual evidence only; use current AssetPlan product sources for behavior.
commands.migrate: Trace Power Apps formulas/state/actions end-to-end before translating to React/TypeScript.
commands.validate: Keep functional, Studio/runtime, responsive, accessibility and visual evidence as separate gates.

prohibitedAssumptions: IUM may override an AssetPlan ADR, design standard, component registry or gate.
An IAP candidate is automatically an AssetPlan baseline.
The highest component revision suffix is the current approved implementation.
Static source inspection is equivalent to Power Apps Studio or visual approval.
A screenshot is sufficient evidence of functional behavior.
A migration may change business semantics merely to simplify the target implementation.
